notes: No local measures on the November 3, 2026 ballot: Garfield County's VoteWA online voters' guide (https://voter.votewa.gov/genericvoterguide.aspx?e=899&c=12) lists only the statewide measures IP26-645, IL26-001 and IL26-638. The county's own site (garfieldcountywa.gov) refuses scripted access, so its sample ballot could not be checked.

Garfield County Commissioner Districts 1 and 3 are nominated by district and elected county-wide in the general (RCW 36.32.040, RCW 36.32.050(1); SOS 2022 and 2024 general precinct results: on all 11 precincts).
